--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -12,5 +12,34 @@
     tau_filter: float,
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
-
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)) or isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
+        raise ValueError('tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number')
+    if tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError('tau_filter must be nonnegative')
+    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'),
+                      (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'),
+                      (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
+        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
+            raise ValueError(f'{name} must be a numpy array')
+        if arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError(f'{name} must be a 2D array')
+        if not np.issubdtype(arr.dtype, np.floating):
+            raise ValueError(f'{name} dtype must be floating')
+        if np.any(np.isnan(arr)) or np.any(np.isinf(arr)):
+            raise ValueError(f'{name} contains non-finite values')
+        if np.any(arr > 0):
+            raise ValueError(f'{name} must be nonpositive')
+    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
+        raise ValueError('All input arrays must have the same shape')
+    n, h = logp_with_result.shape
+    if n == 0 or h == 0:
+        raise ValueError('Input arrays must not be empty')
+    sum_with = np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
+    sum_call = np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
+    sum_no = np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)
+    loss_with = -sum_with
+    loss_call = -sum_call
+    loss_no = -sum_no
+    margin = np.minimum(loss_no - loss_with, loss_call - loss_with)
+    keep = margin > tau_filter
+    return keep, margin
